boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Tufts University
boards.description: Current, under-21-safe food stops on campus and around the Medford/Somerville campus area with posted evening availability.

cards.title: Commons Marketplace Late Night
cards.subtitle: Mayer Campus Center, Tufts University
cards.notes: Check the dining calendar before heading over; Friday and Saturday late-night service is listed separately from regular Marketplace hours.
cards.short_summary: The on-campus option with the latest published weekend dining window.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts Dining lists Commons Marketplace Late Night on Fridays and Saturdays from 9:00 p.m. to 12:30 a.m.
cards.source_title: Regular Hours of Operation | Tufts Dining
cards.access_notes: Tufts Dining’s current hours page lists Late Night Friday and Saturday service, 9:00 p.m.–12:30 a.m.; confirm service when campus is in session.

cards.title: Hodgdon Food-on-the-Run
cards.subtitle: Tufts University
cards.notes: Use the weekday window for an evening pickup and verify the day before walking over, since Friday and weekend service differs.
cards.short_summary: A campus takeout counter with published Monday–Thursday evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts Dining lists Hodgdon open Monday through Thursday until 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Regular Hours of Operation | Tufts Dining
cards.access_notes: Current Tufts Dining hours show Monday–Thursday 9:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; Friday ends at 4:00 p.m. and it is closed weekends.

cards.title: Pizza Days
cards.subtitle: 364 Boston Ave, Medford
cards.notes: Use the posted Boston Avenue location and check ordering availability before leaving; the restaurant’s schedule lists a 3:00 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A Boston Avenue pizza stop with the latest daily closing time in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Days lists its Tufts and Somerville location at 364 Boston Ave and posts daily hours ending at 3:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official store page lists Sunday noon–3:00 a.m., Monday–Friday 3:30 p.m.–3:00 a.m., and Saturday noon–3:00 a.m.

cards.title: Casa Pizza
cards.subtitle: 62 Lambert St, Medford
cards.notes: Plan this as a pickup or delivery option and use Casa Pizza’s hours page for the relevant night; weekend closing is posted later.
cards.short_summary: A Medford pizza shop with midnight-or-later hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Casa Pizza posts hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Casa Pizza’s official hours page lists noon–midnight Monday–Thursday, noon–1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 4:00 p.m.–midnight Sunday.

cards.title: Mei Ling's
cards.subtitle: 434 Salem St A, Medford
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s contact page before going; it posts different late closing times for weekdays, Friday/Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Medford restaurant posting evening hours through midnight or later.
cards.evidence_claim: Mei Ling's posts hours through 12:30 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and midnight Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The business’s contact page lists 2:30 p.m.–12:30 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 2:30 p.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 2:30 p.m.–midnight Sunday.

cards.title: Yoshi's Japanese and Korean Cuisine
cards.subtitle: 132 College Ave, Somerville
cards.notes: Use the College Avenue address and check the restaurant FAQ before a late visit; its published closing time varies across the week.
cards.short_summary: A College Avenue restaurant that posts 10 p.m.-plus dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Yoshi's lists 10:00 p.m. closing Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday, and 10:15 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Yoshi's Japanese and Korean Cuisine — FAQ
cards.access_notes: Yoshi’s FAQ lists 11:30 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday; Friday–Saturday run to 10:15 p.m.; Tuesday is closed.

cards.title: Anna's Taqueria Davis Square
cards.subtitle: 236 Elm St, Somerville
cards.notes: Check the Davis Square location’s own schedule before leaving; its posted Friday and Saturday hours run later than the weekday schedule.
cards.short_summary: A Davis Square taqueria with a posted 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday close.
cards.evidence_claim: Anna's Taqueria lists its Davis Square location open until 11:30 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: The official Davis Square page lists 10:00 a.m.–11:30 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:00 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: JP Licks Davis Square
cards.subtitle: 4A College Ave, Somerville
cards.notes: Use the location listing, not a general search result, to confirm the evening schedule; Friday and Saturday have the latest posted close.
cards.short_summary: A Davis Square dessert stop with published 11 p.m. and midnight hours.
cards.evidence_claim: JP Licks lists Davis Square open until 11:00 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and until midnight Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: JP Licks’ official locations page lists Davis Square hours of 11:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. most days and 11:00 a.m.–midnight Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Mike's On Davis
cards.subtitle: 9 Davis Square, Somerville
cards.notes: Make this a Friday or Saturday dinner plan for the later window; the restaurant’s official page posts its hours by day grouping.
cards.short_summary: A Davis Square restaurant with an 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Mike's On Davis lists Friday and Saturday hours from 10:30 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists Sunday–Thursday 10:30 a.m.–10:00 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 10:30 a.m.–11:00 p.m.

cards.title: Kushari & Grill
cards.subtitle: 321 Boston Ave, Medford
cards.notes: Confirm the listed restaurant schedule before heading out; its official contact page currently posts service through 10:30 p.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Boston Avenue restaurant with a published nightly 10:30 p.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Kushari & Grill lists its Medford address at 321 Boston Ave and posts daily hours from noon to 10:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Kushari & Grill’s official contact page lists restaurant hours Monday–Sunday, 12:00 p.m.–10:30 p.m.
